Privacy policy

This Privacy Policy explains how Tuklogic (“we,” “our,” or “us”) collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you visit our website, [insert website URL], or interact with our services.

Tuklogic provides technology and digital solutions, including software and application development, Generative AI, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP), AI solutions, IoT, cloud computing, CRM, ServiceNow, Quality Assurance, digital marketing, IT and non-IT staffing, and ERP solutions.

This policy applies to information collected through our website, contact forms, service inquiries, career applications, and other interactions with Tuklogic through our digital platforms. Our goal is to handle your personal information responsibly, maintain transparency about our data practices, and protect your privacy while you engage with our website and services.

This Privacy Policy applies to all individuals who visit or interact with the Tuklogic website, including prospective clients, existing clients, business partners, job applicants, website visitors, and individuals who contact us to learn more about our services.

It also applies to individuals who share personal information with Tuklogic through contact forms, service inquiries, career applications, email communications, or other interactions with our digital platforms.

This policy explains how we handle personal information collected through these interactions and outlines the rights and choices available to individuals regarding their information. By using our website or submitting information through our forms, you acknowledge that you have had the opportunity to read this Privacy Policy.

If you do not agree with the practices described in this policy, please exercise caution when sharing personal information through our website. Where applicable, you may contact us to understand our privacy practices or request information about how your personal data is handled.

How We Use Personal Information

Tuklogic collects and uses personal information to operate our website, respond to inquiries, provide information about our services, communicate with prospective and existing clients, manage recruitment activities, and improve our digital platforms.

Information We May Collect

Depending on how you interact with our website, we may collect the following types of information:

  • Contact information: Your name, email address, phone number, company name, and other details you provide through contact forms or service inquiries.
  • Business and project information: Details about your organization, business requirements, project goals, and the services you are interested in.
  • Career-related information: Information included in job applications, resumes, cover letters, employment history, qualifications, and other materials submitted when applying for a position.
  • Technical information: Information such as your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and website usage data, where collected through server logs, analytics tools, or similar technologies.

How We Use Personal Information

We may use the information we collect to:

  • Respond to questions, contact requests, and business inquiries.
  • Understand your requirements and recommend relevant services.
  • Communicate with you about projects, proposals, and potential business relationships.
  • Review job applications and manage recruitment processes.
  • Operate, maintain, secure, and improve our website and services.
  • Analyze website performance and understand visitor engagement.
  • Prevent fraud, detect security issues, and protect our systems.
  • Meet applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual obligations.

How We Share Personal Information

Tuklogic does not sell personal information to third parties. We may share information when necessary with trusted service providers that help us operate our website, manage communications, process recruitment applications, host our systems, or analyze website performance.

We may also disclose information when required by law, to respond to lawful requests from public authorities, to protect our rights and security, or in connection with a business restructuring, merger, or acquisition, where permitted by applicable law.

When we work with third-party service providers, we aim to share only the information reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose and to use appropriate safeguards.

Data Retention and Protection

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information and the reason it was collected.

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure. However, no method of online transmission or electronic storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Your Choices and Privacy Rights

Depending on applicable law, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, or to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent. You may also contact us with questions about how your information is collected, used, or shared.

To make a privacy-related request, please contact us using the contact details provided in this Privacy Policy.

Updates to This Policy

Tuklogic may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our website, services, business practices, or applicable legal requirements. Any updates will be published on this page, along with the revised effective date where appropriate.

How Tuklogic Collects, Uses, and Protects Your Personal Information

How We Collect, Use, and Protect Your Personal Information

Tuklogic respects your privacy and is committed to handling personal information responsibly. This section explains what information we may collect when you visit our website or interact with us, why we collect it, and how we use, store, and protect it.

1. Information We Collect

The information we collect depends on how you interact with our website and services.

Personal and contact information: When you contact us, submit an inquiry, or request information about our services, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, company name, job title, and any other details you voluntarily provide.

Business and project information: If you inquire about our services, we may collect information about your organization, project requirements, business objectives, technical needs, budget expectations, and preferred timelines.

Career and recruitment information: If you apply for a position at Tuklogic, we may collect your resume, contact details, educational qualifications, professional experience, skills, portfolio, and other information you choose to include in your application.

Technical and usage information: When you visit our website, certain technical information may be collected automatically, depending on the technologies we use. This may include your IP address, browser type, device information, operating system, pages visited, referring website, and general website usage activity.

Cookies and similar technologies: Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to support essential website functions, remember preferences, analyze performance, and improve the user experience. Where required, we will request consent before using non-essential cookies.

2. Why We Collect Personal Information

Tuklogic may collect personal information for the following purposes:

  • To respond to contact requests, questions, and service inquiries.
  • To understand business requirements and discuss suitable technology solutions.
  • To prepare proposals, estimates, demonstrations, or project plans when requested.
  • To communicate with prospective clients, existing clients, and business partners.
  • To receive, assess, and manage job applications.
  • To operate, maintain, and improve our website and digital services.
  • To understand website traffic, identify usability issues, and improve performance.
  • To protect our website, systems, and users against fraud, misuse, and security threats.
  • To comply with applicable legal obligations and establish, exercise, or defend legal claims where necessary.
  • We aim to collect only the information reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose.

3. How We Use Personal Information

We use personal information for legitimate business purposes and, where required, on an appropriate legal basis, such as your consent, taking steps at your request before entering into a contract, performing a contract, complying with legal obligations, or pursuing legitimate interests where permitted by law.

For example, when you submit a contact form, we may use the information you provide to understand your requirements and respond to your inquiry. When you apply for a job, we may use your application details to assess your qualifications and communicate with you about the recruitment process.

We may also use technical and usage information to monitor website performance, troubleshoot problems, improve security, and understand how visitors interact with our website.

We will not use personal information for purposes that are incompatible with the purposes described in this policy unless we have an appropriate legal basis or obtain consent where required.

4. How We Share Personal Information

Tuklogic does not sell personal information to third parties. We may share information in limited circumstances, including:

  • Service providers: We may share information with trusted third-party providers that support our website hosting, cloud infrastructure, email communications, analytics, recruitment processes, security, and other business operations.
  • Professional advisers: We may disclose information to legal, accounting, or other professional advisers when reasonably necessary for business or legal purposes.
  • Legal and regulatory requirements: We may disclose information when required

Log Data We Collect Automatically

Log Data

When you visit the Tuklogic website, certain technical information may be collected automatically by our servers or through website technologies to help us maintain, secure, and improve the website. This information is commonly referred to as Log Data.

Depending on the website configuration and the technologies we use, Log Data may include:

  • IP address: The internet protocol address associated with your device or network connection.
  • Browser information: The type and version of the browser you use to access our website.
  • Device and operating system information: General information about your device, operating system, and technical environment.
  • Pages visited: The pages or sections of our website you access, along with the date, time, and approximate duration of your visit.
  • Referring URLs: The website address or link that directed you to our website, where available.
  • Technical activity: Information about requests made to our website, errors encountered, and other technical events necessary for troubleshooting and security monitoring.

How We Use Log Data

We may use Log Data to operate and maintain our website, identify and resolve technical issues, monitor performance, detect suspicious activity, protect against unauthorized access, and understand general website usage.

This information may also help us improve website functionality, reliability, and user experience. Where appropriate, we may use aggregated or anonymized data for statistical analysis and website performance evaluation.

Storage and Retention of Log Data

Log Data may be stored in server logs, hosting systems, security tools, or other technical services used to operate the website. We retain this information only for as long as reasonably necessary for security, troubleshooting, operational, and legal purposes, subject to applicable requirements.

Sharing of Log Data

We may allow authorized hosting providers, website administrators, security providers, or other service providers to process Log Data when necessary to maintain and protect our website. We may also disclose relevant information when required by applicable law.

Your Privacy

Log Data may sometimes be associated with other information that could identify an individual. Where applicable, Tuklogic handles such information in accordance with this Privacy Policy and relevant data protection requirements.

Please note that the exact types of Log Data collected depend on our website infrastructure, hosting configuration, analytics tools, and security services.

Third-Party Service Providers and Their Responsibilities

Tuklogic may work with trusted third-party companies and service providers to support the operation, maintenance, security, and improvement of our website and services. These providers may help us deliver reliable digital experiences, manage communications, analyze website performance, and support our business operations.

When third-party providers process personal information on our behalf, we aim to share only the information reasonably necessary for them to perform their assigned functions. We also seek to use appropriate contractual, technical, and organizational safeguards to protect personal information, where applicable.

Third-party providers may process information only for the purposes relevant to the services they provide, subject to applicable agreements and legal requirements.

  • Website Hosting and Cloud Infrastructure: To host, maintain, and deliver our website and support the secure storage and processing of information.
  • Analytics and Performance Monitoring: To understand website traffic, evaluate user interactions, identify technical issues, and improve website functionality and performance.
  • Communication and Customer Relationship Management: To manage contact form submissions, respond to inquiries, maintain business communications, and coordinate interactions with prospective and existing clients.
  • Security and Technical Support: To detect suspicious activity, prevent unauthorized access, troubleshoot technical problems, and protect the reliability and security of our website and systems.

Third-party service providers may access or process personal information only when reasonably necessary to perform the services they provide to Tuklogic. We aim to work with providers that maintain appropriate security measures and handle personal information in accordance with applicable data protection laws and relevant contractual obligations.

Where required, we establish agreements that define how personal information may be processed, limit its use to authorized purposes, and require appropriate safeguards against unauthorized access, disclosure, loss, or misuse. Our service providers are not authorized to use personal information obtained on our behalf for unrelated purposes, except where permitted or required by applicable law.

We may also disclose personal information to comply with legal obligations, respond to lawful requests from public authorities, protect our rights and security, or support a business transaction where legally permitted.

Although we take reasonable steps to select and work with responsible service providers, third-party websites and services may operate under their own privacy policies. We encourage you to review those policies when interacting directly with external platforms.

If you have questions about how third-party providers may process your personal information, please contact Tuklogic using the contact details provided on our website.

How We Protect Your Personal Information

Security

At Tuklogic, we take the security of personal information seriously and aim to protect the information entrusted to us. We use reasonable technical, organizational, and administrative measures designed to safeguard personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss, misuse, or destruction.

Security Measures

Depending on the nature of the information we collect and the systems we use, our security measures may include:

  • Access Controls: Restricting access to personal information to authorized individuals who need it for legitimate business purposes.
  • Secure Infrastructure: Using appropriate website hosting, server configurations, and security practices to help protect information stored or processed through our systems.
  • Monitoring and Maintenance: Monitoring systems and addressing technical issues or suspicious activity where appropriate.
  • Data Handling Practices: Taking reasonable steps to manage, store, and share personal information responsibly.
  • Third-Party Safeguards: Seeking to work with service providers that maintain appropriate security measures when they process personal information on our behalf.

Limitations of Security

Although we take reasonable steps to protect personal information, no website, internet transmission, electronic storage system, or security measure can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Information transmitted over the internet may be exposed to risks beyond our control, and unauthorized access or security incidents may occur despite reasonable precautions.

For this reason, Tuklogic cannot guarantee the absolute security of information transmitted to or stored by us. You should use caution when sharing sensitive information online and avoid submitting confidential details through general website forms unless specifically requested through an appropriate and secure process.

Your Responsibility

You are responsible for ensuring that the information you submit through our website is appropriate to share. If we provide you with access credentials for any service or platform, you should keep those credentials confidential and notify us promptly if you believe they have been compromised.

Security Incidents

If we become aware of a security incident affecting personal information under our responsibility, we will take reasonable steps to investigate, contain, and address the incident. Where required by applicable law, we will notify affected individuals and relevant authorities within the prescribed timeframes.

Contact Us About Security

If you have concerns about the security of your personal information or believe that information submitted to Tuklogic has been compromised, please contact us using the contact details provided on our website.

Links to Third-Party Websites and External Services

Links to Other Sites

The Tuklogic website may contain links to third-party websites, platforms, or online services for your convenience, reference, or additional information. These links may include external resources, partner websites, social media platforms, and other services that are not operated or controlled by Tuklogic.

If you click a third-party link, you will be directed to that external website or service. Please be aware that these websites may have their own privacy policies, terms of use, cookie practices, and data collection procedures that differ from ours.

Tuklogic does not control and is not responsible for the privacy practices, content, security, availability, or policies of third-party websites. Including a link on our website does not necessarily imply endorsement of the external website, its products, or its services.

We encourage you to review the privacy policy and terms of use of any third-party website you visit before providing personal information or engaging with its services. Any information you choose to share directly with a third party will be handled according to that third party's applicable policies and practices.

Please exercise caution when navigating to external websites, particularly when submitting personal information, creating accounts, making payments, or downloading files.

If you have questions about links appearing on the Tuklogic website, please contact us using the contact information provided on our website.

Your Privacy Rights and Choices

Children's Privacy and Age Restrictions

The Tuklogic website and services are intended for businesses, professionals, job applicants, and individuals who are legally permitted to use our website and services under applicable laws.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children where parental consent or other legal authorization is required unless the applicable legal requirements have been met. If you are a parent or legal guardian and believe that a child has provided personal information to Tuklogic without the required consent or authorization, please contact us using the contact details provided on our website.

If we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child in circumstances that violate applicable law, we will take reasonable steps to review the situation and delete the information or take other appropriate action where required.

Parents and legal guardians are encouraged to supervise children's online activities and help them understand the importance of protecting their personal information when using websites and online services.

The age requirements and protections that apply to personal information may vary depending on the individual's location and applicable data protection laws. Tuklogic will handle children's personal information in accordance with the legal requirements that apply to our activities.

Updates to Our Privacy Policy

Changes to This Privacy Policy

Tuklogic may update or revise this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our business practices, website functionality, technology, data collection and processing activities, or applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

When we make changes, the updated Privacy Policy will be published on this page. We may also update the “Last Updated” or effective date to indicate when the revised policy takes effect.

We encourage you to review this page periodically to stay informed about how we collect, use, store, and protect personal information. Your continued use of our website after an updated policy has been published does not override any rights or requirements that apply under applicable data protection laws.

If a change materially affects how we process personal information, we will provide additional notice or obtain consent where required by applicable law. Where appropriate, such notice may be provided through our website, email, or other suitable communication channels.

The revised Privacy Policy will apply from its stated effective date, unless otherwise specified. Any personal information collected or processed will continue to be handled in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

If you have questions about changes to this Privacy Policy or how they affect your personal information, please contact Tuklogic using the contact details provided on our website.

Contact Tuklogic About Your Privacy

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or how Tuklogic collects, uses, stores, or protects your personal information, we encourage you to contact us.

You can reach out to us through the contact form available on our website or by using the contact details listed on our Contact Us page. Please provide sufficient details about your inquiry so that we can understand your concern and respond appropriately.

If you wish to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, or exercise any other privacy rights available under applicable law, please mention the nature of your request in your message. We may need to verify your identity before processing certain requests.

الأسئلة المتكررة

نقدم خدمات تقنية المعلومات المتكاملة والتوظيف تحت سقف واحد. تشمل خدماتنا حلول إنترنت الأشياء (IoT)، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ ودعم منصات Workday وServiceNow وSalesforce. كما نوفر كفاءات متخصصة في تقنية المعلومات بعقود مؤقتة أو دائمة لتعزيز فريقكم. سواء كنتم بحاجة إلى مشروع متكامل أو إلى مواهب محددة، نصمم حلولنا بما يتوافق مع أهدافكم. تواصلوا معنا للحصول على استشارة مجانية، وسنرشح لكم الحل والفريق الأنسب لاحتياجاتكم.
نعم، نقوم بتنفيذ ودعم منصات Workday وServiceNow وSalesforce للشركات بمختلف أحجامها. يتولى فريقنا كل المراحل، من جمع المتطلبات والإعداد والتهيئة إلى التكامل مع الأنظمة ونقل البيانات والتدريب والدعم المستمر. كما نوفر مستشارين معتمدين بعقود مؤقتة إذا كنتم بحاجة إلى خبرة إضافية. تواصلوا معنا للحصول على استشارة مجانية، وسنقيّم احتياجاتكم ونوصي بأفضل نهج تنفيذ يناسب أعمالكم.
نعم، نقدم حلول إنترنت الأشياء إلى جانب الاستشارات التقنية وخدمات التوظيف. يساعدكم فريقنا على تخطيط الأجهزة المتصلة وأجهزة الاستشعار ومنصات البيانات وبنائها ودمجها، ثم ندعمها بعد الإطلاق. كما نوفر مهندسي إنترنت الأشياء ومتخصصي تقنية المعلومات بعقود مؤقتة أو دائمة لتعزيز فريقكم. تواصلوا معنا للحصول على استشارة مجانية، وسنوصي بالحل والكفاءات الأنسب لأهدافكم.
نعم، نوفر متخصصين في تقنية المعلومات للمشاريع قصيرة الأجل والعقود طويلة الأمد والوظائف الدائمة. يفهم فريقنا متطلباتكم التقنية، ويقوم بفرز المرشحين وفق المهارات المناسبة وملاءمة ثقافة الشركة، ويقدم لكم ملفات مؤهلة بسرعة. نغطي المطورين ومهندسي الحوسبة السحابية وإنترنت الأشياء، إضافةً إلى متخصصي Workday وServiceNow وSalesforce. تواصلوا معنا للحصول على استشارة مجانية، وسنوفر لكم الكفاءات المناسبة لمشروعكم وميزانيتكم.
نعم، نساعد الشركات على تبني الذكاء الاصطناعي من خلال الحلول والكفاءات معًا. يستطيع فريقنا تخطيط وبناء ميزات مدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي، وأتمتة سير العمل، ودمج الذكاء الاصطناعي في منصات مثل Salesforce وServiceNow وWorkday. كما نوفر مهندسي ذكاء اصطناعي وتعلم آلي بعقود مؤقتة أو دائمة. تواصلوا معنا للحصول على استشارة مجانية، وسنقيّم حالة الاستخدام لديكم ونوصي بالنهج والفريق الأنسب.

Privacy policy

This Privacy Policy explains how Tuklogic (“we,” “our,” or “us”) collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you visit our website, [insert website URL], or interact with our services.

Tuklogic provides technology and digital solutions, including software and application development, Generative AI, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP), AI solutions, IoT, cloud computing, CRM, ServiceNow, Quality Assurance, digital marketing, IT and non-IT staffing, and ERP solutions.

This policy applies to information collected through our website, contact forms, service inquiries, career applications, and other interactions with Tuklogic through our digital platforms. Our goal is to handle your personal information responsibly, maintain transparency about our data practices, and protect your privacy while you engage with our website and services.

This Privacy Policy applies to all individuals who visit or interact with the Tuklogic website, including prospective clients, existing clients, business partners, job applicants, website visitors, and individuals who contact us to learn more about our services.

It also applies to individuals who share personal information with Tuklogic through contact forms, service inquiries, career applications, email communications, or other interactions with our digital platforms.

This policy explains how we handle personal information collected through these interactions and outlines the rights and choices available to individuals regarding their information. By using our website or submitting information through our forms, you acknowledge that you have had the opportunity to read this Privacy Policy.

If you do not agree with the practices described in this policy, please exercise caution when sharing personal information through our website. Where applicable, you may contact us to understand our privacy practices or request information about how your personal data is handled.

How We Use Personal Information

Tuklogic collects and uses personal information to operate our website, respond to inquiries, provide information about our services, communicate with prospective and existing clients, manage recruitment activities, and improve our digital platforms.

Information We May Collect

Depending on how you interact with our website, we may collect the following types of information:

  • Contact information: Your name, email address, phone number, company name, and other details you provide through contact forms or service inquiries.
  • Business and project information: Details about your organization, business requirements, project goals, and the services you are interested in.
  • Career-related information: Information included in job applications, resumes, cover letters, employment history, qualifications, and other materials submitted when applying for a position.
  • Technical information: Information such as your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and website usage data, where collected through server logs, analytics tools, or similar technologies.

How We Use Personal Information

We may use the information we collect to:

  • Respond to questions, contact requests, and business inquiries.
  • Understand your requirements and recommend relevant services.
  • Communicate with you about projects, proposals, and potential business relationships.
  • Review job applications and manage recruitment processes.
  • Operate, maintain, secure, and improve our website and services.
  • Analyze website performance and understand visitor engagement.
  • Prevent fraud, detect security issues, and protect our systems.
  • Meet applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual obligations.

How We Share Personal Information

Tuklogic does not sell personal information to third parties. We may share information when necessary with trusted service providers that help us operate our website, manage communications, process recruitment applications, host our systems, or analyze website performance.

We may also disclose information when required by law, to respond to lawful requests from public authorities, to protect our rights and security, or in connection with a business restructuring, merger, or acquisition, where permitted by applicable law.

When we work with third-party service providers, we aim to share only the information reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose and to use appropriate safeguards.

Data Retention and Protection

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information and the reason it was collected.

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure. However, no method of online transmission or electronic storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Your Choices and Privacy Rights

Depending on applicable law, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, or to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent. You may also contact us with questions about how your information is collected, used, or shared.

To make a privacy-related request, please contact us using the contact details provided in this Privacy Policy.

Updates to This Policy

Tuklogic may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our website, services, business practices, or applicable legal requirements. Any updates will be published on this page, along with the revised effective date where appropriate.

How Tuklogic Collects, Uses, and Protects Your Personal Information

How We Collect, Use, and Protect Your Personal Information

Tuklogic respects your privacy and is committed to handling personal information responsibly. This section explains what information we may collect when you visit our website or interact with us, why we collect it, and how we use, store, and protect it.

1. Information We Collect

The information we collect depends on how you interact with our website and services.

Personal and contact information: When you contact us, submit an inquiry, or request information about our services, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, company name, job title, and any other details you voluntarily provide.

Business and project information: If you inquire about our services, we may collect information about your organization, project requirements, business objectives, technical needs, budget expectations, and preferred timelines.

Technical and usage information: When you visit our website, certain technical information may be collected automatically, depending on the technologies we use. Tuklogic may collect personal information for the following purposes:

  • To respond to contact requests, questions, and service inquiries.
  • To understand business requirements and discuss suitable technology solutions.

  • To receive, assess, and manage job applications.

  • To understand website traffic, identify usability issues, and improve performance.
  • To protect our website, systems, and users against fraud, misuse, and security threats.
  • To comply with applicable legal obligations and establish, exercise, or defend legal claims where necessary.
  • We aim to collect only the information reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose.

3. How We Use Personal Information

We use personal information for legitimate business purposes and, where required, on an appropriate legal basis, such as your consent, taking steps at your request before entering into a contract, performing a contract, complying with legal obligations, or pursuing legitimate interests where permitted by law.

For example, when you submit a contact form, we may use the information you provide to understand your requirements and respond to your inquiry. When you apply for a job, we may use your application details to assess your qualifications and communicate with you about the recruitment process.

We may also use technical and usage information to monitor website performance, troubleshoot problems, improve security, and understand how visitors interact with our website.

We will not use personal information for purposes that are incompatible with the purposes described in this policy unless we have an appropriate legal basis or obtain consent where required.

4. How We Share Personal Information

Tuklogic does not sell personal information to third parties. We may share information in limited circumstances, including:

  • Service providers: We may share information with trusted third-party providers that support our website hosting, cloud infrastructure, email communications, analytics, recruitment processes, security, and other business operations.
  • Professional advisers: We may disclose information to legal, accounting, or other professional advisers when reasonably necessary for business or legal purposes.
  • Legal and regulatory requirements: We may disclose information when required

Log Data We Collect Automatically

Log Data

When you visit the Tuklogic website, certain technical information may be collected automatically by our servers or through website technologies to help us maintain, secure, and improve the website. This information is commonly referred to as Log Data.

Depending on the website configuration and the technologies we use, Log Data may include:

  • IP address: The internet protocol address associated with your device or network connection.
  • Browser information: The type and version of the browser you use to access our website.
  • Device and operating system information: General information about your device, operating system, and technical environment.
  • Pages visited: The pages or sections of our website you access, along with the date, time, and approximate duration of your visit.
  • Referring URLs: The website address or link that directed you to our website, where available.
  • Technical activity: Information about requests made to our website, errors encountered, and other technical events necessary for troubleshooting and security monitoring.

How We Use Log Data

We may use Log Data to operate and maintain our website, identify and resolve technical issues, monitor performance, detect suspicious activity, protect against unauthorized access, and understand general website usage.

This information may also help us improve website functionality, reliability, and user experience. Where appropriate, we may use aggregated or anonymized data for statistical analysis and website performance evaluation.

Storage and Retention of Log Data

Log Data may be stored in server logs, hosting systems, security tools, or other technical services used to operate the website. We retain this information only for as long as reasonably necessary for security, troubleshooting, operational, and legal purposes, subject to applicable requirements.

Sharing of Log Data

We may allow authorized hosting providers, website administrators, security providers, or other service providers to process Log Data when necessary to maintain and protect our website. We may also disclose relevant information when required by applicable law.

Your Privacy

Log Data may sometimes be associated with other information that could identify an individual. Where applicable, Tuklogic handles such information in accordance with this Privacy Policy and relevant data protection requirements.

Please note that the exact types of Log Data collected depend on our website infrastructure, hosting configuration, analytics tools, and security services.

Third-Party Service Providers and Their Responsibilities

Tuklogic may work with trusted third-party companies and service providers to support the operation, maintenance, security, and improvement of our website and services. These providers may help us deliver reliable digital experiences, manage communications, analyze website performance, and support our business operations.

When third-party providers process personal information on our behalf, we aim to share only the information reasonably necessary for them to perform their assigned functions. We also seek to use appropriate contractual, technical, and organizational safeguards to protect personal information, where applicable.

Third-party providers may process information only for the purposes relevant to the services they provide, subject to applicable agreements and legal requirements.

  • Website Hosting and Cloud Infrastructure: To host, maintain, and deliver our website and support the secure storage and processing of information.
  • Analytics and Performance Monitoring: To understand website traffic, evaluate user interactions, identify technical issues, and improve website functionality and performance.
  • Communication and Customer Relationship Management: To manage contact form submissions, respond to inquiries, maintain business communications, and coordinate interactions with prospective and existing clients.
  • Security and Technical Support: To detect suspicious activity, prevent unauthorized access, troubleshoot technical problems, and protect the reliability and security of our website and systems.

Third-party service providers may access or process personal information only when reasonably necessary to perform the services they provide to Tuklogic. We aim to work with providers that maintain appropriate security measures and handle personal information in accordance with applicable data protection laws and relevant contractual obligations.

Where required, we establish agreements that define how personal information may be processed, limit its use to authorized purposes, and require appropriate safeguards against unauthorized access, disclosure, loss, or misuse. Our service providers are not authorized to use personal information obtained on our behalf for unrelated purposes, except where permitted or required by applicable law.

We may also disclose personal information to comply with legal obligations, respond to lawful requests from public authorities, protect our rights and security, or support a business transaction where legally permitted.

Although we take reasonable steps to select and work with responsible service providers, third-party websites and services may operate under their own privacy policies. We encourage you to review those policies when interacting directly with external platforms.

If you have questions about how third-party providers may process your personal information, please contact Tuklogic using the contact details provided on our website.

How We Protect Your Personal Information

Security

At Tuklogic, we take the security of personal information seriously and aim to protect the information entrusted to us. We use reasonable technical, organizational, and administrative measures designed to safeguard personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss, misuse, or destruction.

Security Measures

Depending on the nature of the information we collect and the systems we use, our security measures may include:

  • Access Controls: Restricting access to personal information to authorized individuals who need it for legitimate business purposes.
  • Secure Infrastructure: Using appropriate website hosting, server configurations, and security practices to help protect information stored or processed through our systems.
  • Monitoring and Maintenance: Monitoring systems and addressing technical issues or suspicious activity where appropriate.
  • Data Handling Practices: Taking reasonable steps to manage, store, and share personal information responsibly.
  • Third-Party Safeguards: Seeking to work with service providers that maintain appropriate security measures when they process personal information on our behalf.

Limitations of Security

Although we take reasonable steps to protect personal information, no website, internet transmission, electronic storage system, or security measure can be guaranteed to be completely secure. Information transmitted over the internet may be exposed to risks beyond our control, and unauthorized access or security incidents may occur despite reasonable precautions.

For this reason, Tuklogic cannot guarantee the absolute security of information transmitted to or stored by us. You should use caution when sharing sensitive information online and avoid submitting confidential details through general website forms unless specifically requested through an appropriate and secure process.

Your Responsibility

You are responsible for ensuring that the information you submit through our website is appropriate to share. If we provide you with access credentials for any service or platform, you should keep those credentials confidential and notify us promptly if you believe they have been compromised.

Security Incidents

If we become aware of a security incident affecting personal information under our responsibility, we will take reasonable steps to investigate, contain, and address the incident. Where required by applicable law, we will notify affected individuals and relevant authorities within the prescribed timeframes.

Contact Us About Security

If you have concerns about the security of your personal information or believe that information submitted to Tuklogic has been compromised, please contact us using the contact details provided on our website.

Please exercise caution when navigating to external websites, particularly when submitting personal information, creating accounts, making payments, or downloading files.

If you have questions about links appearing on the Tuklogic website, please contact us using the contact information provided on our website.

تُعد توكلوجيك (Tuklogic) شركة متكاملة لحلول تقنية المعلومات والكفاءات، تخدم الشركات في [الدولة/المناطق] ولديها فرق عمل في [المدينة/المدن]. نتخصص في خدمات تقنية المعلومات، وتنفيذ ودعم حلول ServiceNow وWorkday وOracle، إضافةً إلى التوظيف في مجالات تقنية المعلومات وغيرها. يساعد مستشارونا المعتمدون ومتخصصو التوظيف لدينا المؤسسات على تحديث عملياتها، وتبسيط سير العمل، وبناء فرق عالية الأداء. [أضف التقدير أو الاعتماد، مثل الشراكات أو الشهادات أو الجوائز أو سنوات الخبرة.] ما يميزنا هو نهج الشريك الواحد: فبدلاً من التعامل مع عدة موردين، يحصل عملاؤنا على الخبرة التقنية المناسبة والكفاءات المناسبة من فريق واحد موثوق، مع التركيز على نتائج قابلة للقياس، وسرعة في التنفيذ، وعلاقات طويلة الأمد.

وراء كل مشروع تنفذه توكلوجيك عملية تسليم منظمة ومجرَّبة. نبدأ بفهم أهداف أعمالك، ثم نصمم حلاً أو خطة توظيف تناسب جدولك الزمني وميزانيتك. يتبع مستشارونا أفضل الممارسات في تنفيذ حلول ServiceNow وWorkday وOracle، مع مراحل واضحة، وفحوصات جودة، وتواصل شفاف في كل مرحلة. أما في مجال التوظيف، فيعتمد متخصصونا عملية فرز دقيقة تشمل تقييم المهارات، والتحقق من الخلفية، ومدى الملاءمة لثقافة الشركة، لنقدم لك كفاءات مؤهلة في مجالات تقنية المعلومات وغيرها بسرعة. وبدعم من [مراكز التسليم / فرق العمل عن بُعد / الدعم على مدار الساعة]، نوفر نماذج تعاقد مرنة تشمل المشاريع، والعقود المؤقتة، والتعاقد المنتهي بالتوظيف، والتعيين الدائم، لتتمكن من التوسع أو التقليص وفق احتياجاتك.

Our Mission and Values

نؤمن في توكلوجيك بأن التقنية تحقق أفضل نتائجها عندما يقودها الأشخاص المناسبون. فالبرمجيات المتميزة وحدها لا تُحدث التحول في أي مؤسسة، بل يصنعه متخصصون يفهمون أهدافك وقطاعك وتحديات عملك اليومية. ولهذا نجمع بين الخبرة في منصات ServiceNow وWorkday وOracle والتوظيف الموثوق في مجالات تقنية المعلومات وغيرها تحت مظلة واحدة.

وبالنسبة لعملائنا، يعني هذا الإيمان تقليل عدد الموردين الذين يتعاملون معهم، وسرعة أكبر في تنفيذ المشاريع، وحلولاً تناسب طريقة عمل فرقهم فعلياً. نتحمل مسؤولية النتائج، ونتواصل بشفافية، ونبني شراكات طويلة الأمد قائمة على الثقة. والنتيجة هي مخاطر أقل، واستفادة أفضل من استثماراتك، وفريق يمكنك الاعتماد عليه مع نمو أعمالك.

نطبق إيماننا من خلال نهج بسيط ومنضبط. نبدأ بالاستماع، فتُبنى كل حلولنا حول أهدافك لا حول قالب جاهز. نخطط على مراحل واضحة، مع محطات إنجاز محددة وتحديثات منتظمة وفحوصات جودة في كل خطوة. يعمل مستشارونا ومتخصصو التوظيف كفريق واحد يتبادل المعرفة، لتبقى التقنية والكفاءات متوافقتين. ونتحلى بالمرونة في مواجهة أي تغيير في النطاق أو الجدول الزمني أو الميزانية. ونقيس نجاحنا بنتائجك، ونواصل دعمك بعد التشغيل أو التعيين بوقت طويل.

تتمتع توكلوجيك بخبرة عميقة في الخدمات التي تعتمد عليها الشركات أكثر من غيرها. تقدم فرقنا خدمات تقنية المعلومات والدعم المُدار، وحلول ServiceNow لسير العمل والأتمتة، وحلول Workday للموارد البشرية والمالية، وتطبيقات Oracle وخدماتها السحابية. وإلى جانب ذلك، يوظف متخصصو التوظيف لدينا كفاءات ماهرة في وظائف تقنية المعلومات وغيرها، من المطورين والمحللين والمهندسين إلى الإداريين وموظفي العمليات والدعم، بعقود مؤقتة أو تعاقد منتهٍ بالتوظيف أو تعيين دائم.

سواء كنت تطلق منصة جديدة، أو تحسّن منصة قائمة، أو تبني فريقك، فلدينا الخبرة لمساعدتك على إنجاز ذلك بإتقان وفي الموعد المحدد.

استكشف خدماتنا ودراسات الحالة لترى كيف نعمل، أو تواصل معنا اليوم لمناقشة أهدافك. دعنا نبنِ معاً ما يدوم.
